sources.subtlex_credit: Freely available SUBTLEX data: US, Brysbaert & New (2009); UK, van Heuven, Mandera, Keuleers & Brysbaert (2014); CH, Cai & Brysbaert (2010); DE, Brysbaert, Buchmeier, Conrad, Jacobs, Bölte & Böhl (2011); NL, Keuleers, Brysbaert & New (2010)

methodology: VERB/AUX lemma occurrences per billion non-PUNCT/non-SYM tokens in UD German GSD; compound:prt children restore separable prefixes. Automatic lemmas can be imperfect. No corpus verb evidence: provisional wordfreq infinitive lookup capped at Zipf 2.5 to prevent article/noun homographs from receiving high verb priority. Small news/reviews/web corpus, not a representative frequency census.
